cases.assertion: A user can save an incomplete post or group draft, resume it on another client, update or delete it, while another account receives 404.
Concurrent native workers and a manual publication produce at most one post and return the stored publication receipt. Editing or cancelling first prevents a pending job from publishing.
If group rights, account access or media availability changes before scheduled publication, no post is created and the draft remains available with a controlled failure state.
Absent schema prevents draft use and scheduled scanning without issuing DDL. Previously recorded migration checksums are preserved.
